rationale.local: A location is local only when it falls inside the exact modeled half-degree cell.
rationale.county: The 80 km county limit is slightly larger than the approximate diagonal of one half-degree cell in these states.
rationale.ecological: The 160 km ecological limit allows at most about two grid diagonals and requires measured environmental similarity.
rationale.statewide: When finer evidence is unavailable, the modal published mixture for the state and planting class is returned as statewide guidance.
